question: Will the San Antonio Spurs have the best win percentage in the NBA Western Conference after all games on 31 December 2026 (US Eastern)?
description: The Spurs and Lakers were both 14-3 in late November 2026.
resolutionSource: NBA Western Conference standings at nba.com on 1 January 2027.

resolutionRules.yesCriteria: Resolve YES if the Spurs are first in the Western Conference by win percentage (ties resolved by official NBA tiebreakers).
resolutionRules.noCriteria: Resolve NO if any other Western Conference team is first.
resolutionRules.invalidCriteria: Resolve Invalid if the event is cancelled or the outcome cannot be established using these rules.
